src/desktop.d.ts: Typed optional native bridge; desktop-only addition.
src/auth/tokenVault.ts: OS safeStorage wrapping of session tokens; sealed bytes remain in existing per-account IndexedDB for complete sign-out erasure.
src/application/updates.ts: Disable hosted shell updates; mirror existing call/upload/download holds to native updater.
src/application/webPush.ts: Use native notifications and disable web service-worker/FCM registration in desktop.
src/auth/socialAuth.ts: Reuse existing proof-bound native platform callback in the system browser; no new account or auth backend.
src/ui/auth/SocialSignIn.tsx: Avoid provider popup inside Electron when native browser sign-in is available.
